info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Warehouse Inventory Audits-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables users to retrieve a comprehensive list of inventory audits conducted within the warehouse. It serves as a vital resource for identifying discrepancies and tracking changes in inventory records over time. The primary resources include audit logs that detail the findings of each inventory assessment. Typical consumers of this API include warehouse managers and inventory analysts who rely on accurate data to support inventory management strategies. Utilize this API to enhance operational transparency and improve stock accuracy.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all the records related to inventory audits. It provides insights into discrepancies, adjustments, and overall inventory management efficiency.

requestBody.description: A JSON object representing the request payload for auditing inventory. This payload may include various parameters required to filter or specify the context of the inventory audit operation.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the inventory audit data.

ListWarehouseInventoryAuditsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the inventory audit API. It is designed to accept a string value.

ListWarehouseInventoryAuditsResponse_200.title: Inventory Audit Response

status.description: Indicates whether the audit operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the reference of the audit.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result generated from the audit operation.

state.description: The current state of the audit process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the audit, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the audit status.

ListWarehouseInventoryAuditsResponse_200.description: The response object for the inventory audit operation, indicating the status and details of the audit process.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the audit.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the audit was generated automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Details regarding the creation of the audit, including creator and timestamp.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken by the server to process the request, allowing clients to measure performance.

schema.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
